data.desc1: Japan Fujika Pumps Co. Ltd is a Japanese manufacturer of high-quality pumping solutions designed for precision and durability. The company is headquartered in Mototoyoda 159, Japan (Post 300-2711).  For the Middle East region, the head office is Fujika Pumps – UAE, with authorized distributors: 	•	Ahd Aljazeera Co. – KSA 	•	Jayatwa Trading Co. – Jordan
data.desc2: Our pumps are built on strict quality control, advanced engineering, and continuous innovation. We integrate high-efficiency motor technology, corrosion-resistant materials, and precision-crafted components, developed to meet rigorous international performance and safety standards.
data.desc3: We collaborate with authorized distributors and partners across multiple regions to ensure genuine products, fast delivery, localized technical support, and long-term service relationships. This network provides dependable access to Japan Fujika Pumps solutions worldwide.
data.desc4: Quality and reliability guide every stage—from design and materials selection to testing and inspection. Each pump is validated for efficiency, durability, safety, and operational stability to deliver consistent performance over an extended service life.

data.address: Head Office 3-11-8 Chuoh Ota-Ku, Tokyo-Japan Postal Code: 143-0024
